original_description: Build an academic literature review matrix (LRM, review matrix, literature matrix, RRL or IMRAD table) in Excel from scholarly papers the user already has, with one row per paper and an APA 7 citation checked against Crossref (retractions flagged), introduction, methodology, theory, results, discussion and Scimago (SJR) journal quartile, sorted A-Z. Also tabulates the user's papers by quartile or method. Builds a synthesis matrix (themes by sources) or a Webster and Watson concept matrix only when the user asks for that exact matrix. Not for finding papers (search strings, PRISMA, database searches, downloads), writing the review chapter, summarising one paper or formatting references; never for SWOT, competitor, risk, decision or other non-academic matrices.
